card.name: Start of bullous and equine words
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word bullous (bull, Bull) in bullous pemphigoid or bullous skin disorders. Also the start of Equine (Equ) in an antivenin name or a business name.

modes.label: Bullous skin disease
modes.description: The opening piece of bullous before pemphigoid or skin-disorder terms.

modes.label: Equine
modes.description: The opening piece of Equine in a product or business name.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the word as a rare medical term, though the listed tokens are unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of the word bullous (blistering skin disease) and sometimes of equine.
